product.title: The Smart Decking Sample Kit
product.description: Inspired by HGTV® Smart Home 2026, this curated sample kit captures a modern coastal aesthetic through a thoughtful selection of Trex colors, including Salt Flat, Millstone, Biscayne, Golden Hour, and Honey Grove. Together, these hues bring warmth, contrast, and versatility, making it easy to explore how different tones and textures can shape an outdoor space that feels fresh, relaxed, and timeless.
